The plots illustrate the progression of training rewards over a series of steps for different models. Both plots share a common x-axis labeled “Steps,” using a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels displayed every 100 steps. The y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards," utilizing a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.4 in the top plot and 0 to 0.2 in the bottom plot.

In the top plot, there are three lines. A cyan line with a triangular marker shape depicts a model labeled “Llama-On-Policy-Easy,” starting at approximately 0.17 rewards at step 0 and increasing to approximately 0.33 rewards at step 500, demonstrating a generally increasing trend with fluctuations. A red line with a circular marker shape represents "Llama-LUFFY-Easy," beginning near 0.19 rewards at step 0 and rising to approximately 0.31 rewards at step 500, exhibiting an overall upward trend, though with variations. Lastly, a green line with a square marker shape shows “Llama-On-Policy-Easy,” beginning at approximately 0.19 rewards at step 0 and reaching approximately 0.33 rewards at step 500, displaying a gradually increasing profile.

The bottom plot contains two lines. A cyan line with a triangular marker depicts “Llama-On-Policy-Hard,” beginning at approximately 0.02 rewards at step 0 and increasing to approximately 0.15 rewards at step 500 with periodic declines. A red line with a circular marker represents "Llama-LUFFY-Hard," starting at approximately 0.01 rewards at step 0 and reaching approximately 0.20 rewards at step 500, showing an upward trend after some initial fluctuations.
